statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit. Search and product paths returned reproducible eBay server errors and were judged as issues, not audit blockers, because the remaining site surfaces were inspectable.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page marketplace with hydrated components
page.notes: Public German commerce marketplace. Representative pages: home, category, deals, search, item detail, and 404. Not covered: authenticated account, checkout/payment completion, seller listing submission, or post-consent partner behavior because they require credentials, transactions, or broader consent scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation left the document and header white; html computed color-scheme was normal and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce there were no running animations, all 12 media elements were paused without autoplay, and two stylesheets contained reduced-motion handling.
The high-contrast capture remained the ordinary palette and CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling.
Rendered CSS contained view-transition rules, showing state changes use the platform transition mechanism.
Rendered CSS contained animation-timeline/scroll-timeline rules rather than relying only on imperative scrolling.
Rendered CSS uses scroll-snap and the homepage carousel presents native-like previous, next, pause, and position controls.
Scroll-timeline/scroll-snap styling and explicit carousel position controls provide state-aware navigation feedback.
Rendered CSS contains anchor positioning rules, and no sampled menu was visibly detached from its trigger.
The hero, carousel markers, labelled category navigation, and strong section headings make current context and next destinations visible.
The consent banner obscures roughly the lower quarter of desktop and almost the entire remaining mobile viewport before interaction.
The page exposed many custom DIV role=dialog nodes but zero native dialog, popover, or details elements.
After consent rejection, the main surface is content-led with a compact two-row header and no enclosing application frame.
At a 360px visual viewport, layout reported 407px scroll width and 47px horizontal overflow.
CSS inspection found 25 container rules, and header/content composition changes between 1440px and 360px.
Programmatic keyboard focus produced a visible auto outline; Lighthouse target-size passed and primary controls remain available without hover.
Homepage, category, and deals surfaces clearly identify eBay browse/search and expose prominent search and offer actions.
A direct search for “iphone 15” and a live item linked from Deals both returned the generic “Something went wrong on our end” error, preventing browse-to-item completion.
Both generic failures and the intentional not-found route explain the state and offer a homepage/back or help recovery path.
Lighthouse measured LCP 17.0s, FCP 8.3s, TBT 410ms and performance 0.46; trace corroborated LCP 4.83s.
The mobile layout observer and Lighthouse both measured CLS 0 with no recorded layout-shift entries.
Lighthouse reported 9.5s main-thread work and 4.2s JavaScript execution; trace found three long tasks up to 97.6ms.
HAR transferred 3.38MB over 89 requests; Lighthouse found 750ms render-blocking savings and weak caching, while DOM inspection confirmed several parser scripts lacked async/defer.
Lighthouse estimated 563KiB unused JavaScript, 138KiB unused CSS, and 55KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR transferred 1.08MB of script.
Lighthouse failed aria-hidden-focus and label/content-name matching; the image primitive reported 29 images without alt.
Lighthouse color-contrast passed with no failing elements.
Keyboard focus was visible, but Lighthouse found no valid main landmark and focusable descendants inside aria-hidden content.
Desktop and mobile captures show readable type, consistent alignment, and no observed text clipping in the sampled content.
Although Lighthouse target-size and viewport checks passed, the 360px layout still overflowed horizontally by 47px, so reflow is incomplete.
Lighthouse reported no browser errors logged to the console.
Document doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but 79 of 80 images lacked explicit dimensions and 35 were oversized.
Lighthouse reported one deprecated API, a BFCache blocker, missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript, and best-practices score 0.81.
The homepage has a descriptive German title and detailed meta description.
Real href links, viewport metadata, readable robots.txt, and Lighthouse SEO 1.00 establish crawlability and mobile indexing signals.
Homepage returned 200, canonical points to https://www.ebay.de/, hreflang enumerates localized variants, and no accidental noindex was observed.
JSON-LD/Open Graph metadata was present in the rendered profile and Lighthouse SEO scored 1.00.
HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff/frame protection are present, but CSP is absent and 16 cookies were flagged without Secure by CDP.
Before consent, the page set 16 cookies and contacted eight non-main origins; HAR classified 76 requests and 2.70MB outside the main origin.
No notification/geolocation prompt appeared on load; credential APIs are available and no password-only wall was introduced in sampled public paths.
HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are set, but CSP, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are absent.
Raw HTML returned 200 with 84% rendered-word coverage and retained title, h1, and description; it is not a JS shell.
Sampled category/deals overlays remained within viewport bounds, and explicit error states replaced broken or blank shells.
eBay is an intrinsically network-dependent commerce marketplace; installability and a general offline transaction flow are not appropriate to this representative public journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: eBay is an intrinsically network-dependent commerce marketplace; installability and a general offline transaction flow are not appropriate to this representative public journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Search/item failures and a 404 each render a clear message and recovery link rather than an infinite spinner or blank shell.
html lang is de-DE, hreflang variants are extensive, and rendered CSS uses logical inline properties.
German copy and locale-appropriate EUR prices such as “EUR 189,99” are rendered consistently.
The event time is explicitly presented in localized German date/time form, providing an unambiguous local user-facing value.
The consent wall blocks content and, on mobile, its reject/customize actions are below the first viewport, creating avoidable consent friction.
Failure screens use neutral language, explain that the problem is on eBay’s side, retain a reference ID, and offer recovery without blaming the user.
Search input and category select have explicit accessible labels, appropriate types, and predictable actions.
A live offer linked from Deals cannot reach its item page and instead returns a generic server error, breaking a commercial flow before pricing/commitment can be completed.
35 images were oversized, 52 lacked srcset, and 20 used legacy formats; images transferred about 2.0MB.
The page shipped 563KiB estimated unused JS, 138KiB unused CSS, and 89 requests on initial load.
Non-main-origin delivery accounted for 76 requests and 2.70MB; initial total transfer was 3.38MB despite no user-started media.
Content is crawler-visible, but no WebMCP, agentic-form, or agentic JavaScript tool registration was exposed for this commerce surface.
No bounded on-device inference task was present in the sampled browse, search, deal, or product journey; absence is not a defect for this emerging contextual check.
checkOutcomes.reason: No bounded on-device inference task was present in the sampled browse, search, deal, or product journey; absence is not a defect for this emerging contextual check.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten carousel-next clicks, snapshot totals were lower (759,595 nodes; 44.6MB) than baseline (813,980 nodes; 63.5MB), with no retained-growth signal.
Baseline heap contained 813,980 nodes, 3.29M edges, and 63.5MB self size, a high initial footprint for a marketplace landing page.
Ten repeated carousel actions did not increase aggregate nodes, edges, or heap self size; no accumulating detached/listener signal was observed at summary level.

paths.description: Homepage entry, global navigation, search, promotional carousel, preferences, mobile reflow, performance, security, discoverability, and consent.
Electronics category archetype representing browse/category templates.
Deals listing archetype and entry into a high-value commercial item journey.
Primary product-search journey for “iphone 15”; returned eBay error page.
Live item linked from Deals, representing product detail and purchase entry; returned eBay error page.
Intentional invalid route to assess HTTP/error recovery state.

findings.summary: No user-preference dark theme
findings.evidence: Dark preference leaves the light document unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme/light-dark().

findings.summary: No explicit high-contrast adaptation
findings.evidence: The stylesheet has no prefers-contrast or forced-colors branch.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations that preserve control boundaries and focus.

findings.summary: Consent UI obscures core content on load
findings.evidence: The banner dominates the mobile first viewport and covers content on desktop.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent treatment with all choices visible and preserve immediate access to core content.

findings.summary: Overlays rely on custom dialog DIVs
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains role=dialog DIVs but no dialog/popover/details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog for modal consent and popover/details for transient disclosures, retaining declarative dismissal and focus handling.

findings.summary: Mobile layout overflows horizontally
findings.evidence: 360px layout is 407px wide, producing 47px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/min widths causing overflow and use intrinsic/fluid sizing within the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Search and item journeys fail
findings.evidence: A common product search and a current Deals item both returned an eBay server error.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore search/item routing for ordinary headless and anonymous users; provide retry that preserves query/item context.

findings.summary: LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse LCP was 17.0s and trace LCP 4.83s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, shorten critical dependencies, and defer non-critical page work.

findings.summary: Initial load performs excessive main-thread work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded 9.5s main-thread work and 4.2s JS execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks and defer, chunk, or remove low-value scripts.

findings.summary: Resource delivery delays primary content
findings.evidence: 3.38MB/89 requests include confirmed parser scripts and render-blocking CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, tighten cache lifetimes, and shorten the critical resource chain.

findings.summary: Large unused and legacy payloads ship on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 563KiB unused JS, 138KiB unused CSS, and 55KiB legacy JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by surface, remove duplicate/legacy branches, and load optional dependencies conditionally.

findings.summary: Accessible names and hidden focus state are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found aria-hidden focus and accessible-name mismatch; 29 images lacked alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove focusable descendants from aria-hidden regions, align names with labels, and add meaningful or empty alt as appropriate.

findings.summary: Main landmark and focus structure are invalid
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark and focusable content under aria-hidden.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose one semantic main landmark and keep focus order/state outside hidden subtrees.

findings.summary: Narrow reflow is incomplete
findings.evidence: The mobile viewport retains 47px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit at 320–400px and zoom, replacing rigid sizing with intrinsic layout.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions and are oversized
findings.evidence: 79/80 images omit width/height and 35 exceed 2x rendered width.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and responsive srcset/sizes for each content image.

findings.summary: Deprecated API and BFCache/source-map hygiene gaps remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a deprecated API, BFCache blocker, and missing source maps.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated calls, remove the BFCache blocker, and publish valid production source maps.

findings.summary: CSP and cookie transport defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: No CSP is returned and CDP flagged 16 cookies without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and mark every HTTPS cookie Secure with the narrowest suitable SameSite/HttpOnly policy.

findings.summary: Pre-consent data footprint is broad
findings.evidence: Initial load sets 16 cookies and contacts eight non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Restrict pre-consent storage/networking to necessary functions and batch/minimize analytics after explicit consent.

findings.summary: Referrer and permissions policies are absent
findings.evidence: Response has no CSP, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy alongside CSP.

findings.summary: Commerce capabilities are not exposed structurally to agents
findings.evidence: No agent tool or agentic form registration was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Explore guarded WebMCP tools for product search and item inspection with explicit user confirmation for actions.

findings.summary: Initial memory footprint is high
findings.evidence: Baseline heap held 813,980 nodes and 63.5MB self size.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile dominant constructors and reduce retained catalog/carousel DOM and boot-time state.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: 35 oversized images, 52 without srcset, and 20 legacy-format files were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive modern-format variants and right-size decorative/catalog imagery.

findings.summary: Initial page ships avoidable work
findings.evidence: Unused code estimates and 89 initial requests show unnecessary processing and transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer offscreen sections and optional dependencies until needed.

findings.summary: Third-party/media budget is disproportionate
findings.evidence: 2.70MB and 76 requests were outside the main origin classification.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an origin/request budget, consolidate first-party subdomain delivery, and defer non-essential media/telemetry.

findings.summary: Consent choice is obstructive on mobile
findings.evidence: On mobile the consent text fills the first viewport and decision controls are below it.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep accept, reject, and customize equally visible without forcing a scroll or blocking browsing.

findings.summary: Deal-to-item commercial flow is unavailable
findings.evidence: A currently advertised deal links to a generic error instead of its item page.
findings.suggestedFix: Make item detail resilient and preserve the item/deal context in recovery and retry actions.

taskList.title: Restore anonymous search and item-detail journey reliability
Reduce LCP, main-thread work, and critical resource chains
Make consent compact, equally actionable, and non-obstructive
Fix semantic landmarks, hidden-focus state, names, and image alternatives
Deploy CSP and least-privilege response/cookie policies
Right-size responsive images and set intrinsic dimensions
Add dark and high-contrast preference themes
Reduce initial retained DOM and heap footprint
Replace custom overlays with semantic platform primitives
Resolve deprecated API, BFCache, and source-map issues
